baseline_description: Exact current retrieved final-edition baseline. The archive is named October 5; its standardized source includes October 8 updates. Preservation is relative to these pinned retrieved bytes, not an asserted original October 5 source.
mode: review-only for inherited mathematical bodies, self-review for owner edits

scope.inherited_traditional: All three inherited parts, including the 184 displayed record environments, 142 theorem-like records, 140 proof bodies, neighboring definitions and prose, original captions, local labels, references, citation keys, and macro conventions.

scope.inherited_lean: Chapters 1–11 prose, equations, formal-scope descriptions, and source/evidence distinctions. Raw theorem listings and excerpts are checked for provenance by the guide owner, not compiled in this proofreading review.

New explanations and finite illustrations do not introduce a new theorem or proof.

preservation.claim_scope: Exact equality of preserved bodies against the current retrieved, October-8-standardized baseline. This does not claim source identity for the full new monograph or the original October 5 archive.

The adjacent section includes a factorization theorem without a two-block restriction. Name the all-prior criterion when introducing the two-block assumption.

findings.finding: The curve 2t exp(-t) exceeds exp(-t) for t>1/2. Use exponential decay factor rather than envelope, to avoid implying an upper bound.
The monograph includes worked atlas Part IV. Refer to the traditional volume instead of three traditional parts.
Describe inherited written Parts I–III followed by the worked atlas in Part IV.
The byte-identity replay compares 40 editable plate sources. Use that exact unit instead of drawings, which could imply rendered PDF byte identity.

limitations: Conservative proofreading checks local consistency and correct reading of existing hypotheses. It is not an adversarial proof-validity audit.
Citation keys and local syntax are checked. Mathematical support from external sources and novelty are outside this review.
